column3: “Said to his heart” is rendered “said to himself,” and “desist” as “despair.”
“Abigail the wife of Nabal” is rendered “Nabal’s widow.”
“Cities of the field” is rendered “cities in the country.”
“Days and four months” is rendered “a year and four months.”
NASB reads “Girzites” (Hebrew written text) and smooths “from antiquity, as you come to Shur.”
The Hebrew reads “against where”; NASB renders “Where have you made a raid?”
“Lest” is rendered “Otherwise,” and “all the days” as “all the time.”
